name: Tidewater Roast
purpose: Online store for Tidewater Roast, a small coffee roaster: browse coffees with photos and prices, cart, guest checkout, and order history lookup.
actors: Customer (order lookup by email via signed links)

entities.name: Order
relationships: has shipping address and shipping charge
has signed access token for receipt lookup

entities.name: OrderLineItem
relationships: snapshots unit price and name at purchase

workflows.name: Browse products
workflows.description: Product cards show photo, roast level, price; detail page shows tasting notes

workflows.name: Add to cart
workflows.description: Add bags to a session cart, adjust quantity, see running subtotal

workflows.name: Guest checkout
workflows.description: Checkout with an email plus shipping address and method; order completes and receipt is reachable through a signed, expiring access link

workflows.name: Past orders
workflows.description: Customer enters their email on the order-lookup page and sees their past orders via signed links

workflows.name: Admin manage
workflows.description: Admin manages products (photo, price, active) and views/cancels orders

seed_demo: Six coffees across three categories (Single Origin, Blends, Espresso) with photos, roast levels, tasting notes and prices; one demo order tied to a demo email shown on the order-lookup page.
